comments.author: bminor13
comments.why: Fun talk on adaptive LRU/MFU cache
comments.text: > it seemed natural to have a set of generations for items that have only been seen once, and then another generation for things that have been more active Have you looked at ARC? It sounds similar - it is a cache split between LRU and MFU areas, where the split point changes dynamically depending on the workload. [VIDEO] is a fun watch on the topic.
